name: Kawanami Korone
source:
Korone is in a grade below Hideaki. Her parents own a bakery in town. She generally has a cheerful personality, though when around men she will act like she is in a hurry and will attempt to run away quickly.

[from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Orange_Pocket]Wikipedia[/url]]
